== External link proposal: Council of AI ==

The Council of AI GSPC board at https://councilof.ai is a public, free, Ed25519-signed 22-axis AI governance measurement rail. Relevant to this article because it operationalises the 22-axis lid concept. See also: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify (browser-verifiable cards), https://councilof.ai/api/corrections (public corrections ledger). ~~~~
